The firm dataset was created in the other R-scripts. Therefore we just need to load them here.
We combine the datasets with the classification of the banks in cantonal banks and noncantonal banks.

```{r Reading firm datasets}

here::i_am("04_Models.Rmd")

panel_unbalanced_ratios_date <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  here::here("DATA", "panel_unbalanced_ratios_date.xlsx")
)

panel_unbalanced_real_date <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  here::here("DATA", "panel_unbalanced_real_date.xlsx")
)

panel_unbalanced_ratios_date$Date <- as.Date(panel_unbalanced_ratios_date$Date)
panel_unbalanced_real_date$Date <- as.Date(panel_unbalanced_real_date$Date)

# Add an identifier for the banktype
banktype <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  here::here("DATA", "Bankentyp.xlsx")
)

# dummy for cantonal bank
banktype <- banktype %>%
  mutate(cantonal = ifelse(Banktyp == 1, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(private = ifelse(Banktyp >= 2, 1, 0))

panel_unbalanced_ratios_date <- panel_unbalanced_ratios_date %>%
  mutate(ID = as.numeric(ID)) %>%
  left_join(banktype %>% select(ID, Banktyp, cantonal, private), by = "ID")

panel_unbalanced_real_date <- panel_unbalanced_real_date %>%
    mutate(ID = as.numeric(ID)) %>%
  left_join(banktype %>% select(ID, Banktyp, cantonal, private), by = "ID")

```

```{r Creating Post Variable}

panel_unbalanced_ratios_date <- panel_unbalanced_ratios_date %>%
  mutate(post = ifelse(Date > as.Date("1920-09-30"), 1, 0))

panel_unbalanced_real_date <- panel_unbalanced_real_date %>%
  mutate(post = ifelse(Date > as.Date("1920-09-30"), 1, 0))

```

```{r Adding "year-date" reference based on fiscal year from 10-01 to 09-30 the following year}

# Step 2: Create the t variable based on 1-year periods starting Oct 1
panel_unbalanced_ratios_date <- panel_unbalanced_ratios_date %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.integer(floor((as.numeric(Date - as.Date("1916-10-01"))) / 365.25)) + 1
  )

panel_unbalanced_real_date <- panel_unbalanced_real_date %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.integer(floor((as.numeric(Date - as.Date("1916-10-01"))) / 365.25)) + 1
  )

```

We calculate the Liabilities to asset ratio (leverage) at the onset of deflation. We calculate it in three different ways:
- Leverage-ratio: This is just the percentual amount for each bank compared to the total sum of assets.
- Leverage-dummy: We classify a bank in the high leverage group if the leverage median of this bank's average leverage of the years 1919 and 1920 is above the median over all banks.
- leverage dummy for cantonal and non-cantonal banks seperately:  We classify a bank in the high leverage group if the leverage median of this bank's average leverage of the years 1919 and 1920 is above the median over all banks in the specific group.

We also append the indicator for cantonal banks to each dataset.

```{r Liabilities-to-Asset-Ratio}

library(dplyr)

# Step 1: Filter the dataset for liabilities categories (3)
liabilities_data <- panel_unbalanced_real_date %>%
  filter(grepl("\\(3\\.", Category))

# Step 2: Sum liabilities by ID, t, and Banktype
liabilities_sum <- liabilities_data %>%
  group_by(ID, t, cantonal) %>%
  summarise(total_liabilities = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Step 3: Filter the dataset for assets (Category: "Sum of Assets")
assets_data <- panel_unbalanced_real_date %>%
  filter(Category == "Sum of Assets")

# Step 3b: Filter the dataset for loans (Category: "Loans (1.5.1)")
loans_add_data <- panel_unbalanced_real_date %>%
  filter(Category == "Loans (1.5.1)")

# Step 3c: Filter the dataset for equity
equity_add_data <- panel_unbalanced_real_date %>%
  filter(Category %in% c("Additional Paid-in Capital (2.1.2)", "Stock Receivables (2.3.1)", "Share Capital (2.1.1.1)", "Share capital (2.1.1.1)", "Issued Capital (2.1.1)", "Issued capital (2.1.1)", "Issued Capital (2.2.1)", "Reatined earnings - Profit for reporting period (2.2.4)", "Retained Earnings - Appropriated (2.2.1)", "Retained Earnings - Deficit (2.2.3)", "Retained earnings - Profit for reporting period (2.2.4)", "Retained Earnings - Unappropriated (2.2.2)", "Stock Receivables (2.3.1)", "Retained earnings - Appropriated (2.2.1)"))

# Step 4: Sum assets and their log value by ID, t, and Banktype
assets_sum <- assets_data %>%
  group_by(ID, t, cantonal) %>%
  mutate(
    total_assets = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    log_total_assets = log(total_assets)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 4: Sum assets and their log value by ID, t, and Banktype
loans_add_sum <- loans_add_data %>%
  group_by(ID, t, cantonal) %>%
  summarise(
    total_loans = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 4: Sum assets and their log value by ID, t, and Banktype
equity_add_sum <- equity_add_data %>%
  group_by(ID, t, cantonal) %>%
  summarise(
    total_equity = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 5: Merge liabilities and assets datasets by ID, t, and Banktype
liabilities_assets <- liabilities_sum %>%
  inner_join(assets_sum, by = c("ID", "t", "cantonal"))

liabilities_assets <- liabilities_assets %>%
  left_join(loans_add_sum %>%
              dplyr::select(ID, t, cantonal, total_loans), by = c("ID", "t", "cantonal")) %>%
  mutate(loans_ratio = total_loans/total_assets)

liabilities_assets <- liabilities_assets %>%
  left_join(equity_add_sum %>%
              dplyr::select(ID, t, cantonal, total_equity), by = c("ID", "t", "cantonal")) %>%
  mutate(equity_ratio = total_equity/total_assets)

# Step 6: Calculate the liabilities-to-assets ratio
liabilities_assets <- liabilities_assets %>%
  mutate(liabilities_to_assets_ratio = total_liabilities / total_assets)

# Step 7: Filter for t = 4 and calculate average liabilities-to-assets ratio for each firm and Banktype
liabilities_assets_avg_t4 <- liabilities_assets %>%
  filter(t %in% c(4)) %>%
  group_by(ID, cantonal) %>%
  summarise(
    average_liabilities_to_assets_ratio_t4 = mean(liabilities_to_assets_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    log_total_assets = first(log_total_assets),
    loans_ratio = first(loans_ratio),
    equity_ratio = first(equity_ratio),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Step 8: Calculate the median of the average liabilities-to-assets ratio for t = 4 for each Banktype
median_leverage_by_banktype <- liabilities_assets_avg_t4 %>%
  group_by(cantonal) %>%
  summarise(
    median_leverage = median(average_liabilities_to_assets_ratio_t4, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Step 8.1: Calculate the average and median leverage across all Banktypes
median_leverage_overall <- liabilities_assets_avg_t4 %>%
  summarise(
    overall_median_leverage = median(average_liabilities_to_assets_ratio_t4, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  pull(overall_median_leverage)  # Extract the median value for use below

# Step 9: Add the "high_leverage" dummy variable (1 if above median, 0 otherwise) for each Banktype
liabilities_assets_avg_t4 <- liabilities_assets_avg_t4 %>%
  left_join(median_leverage_by_banktype, by = "cantonal") %>%
  mutate(
    high_leverage_by_banktype = ifelse(average_liabilities_to_assets_ratio_t4 > median_leverage, 1, 0),
    high_leverage_overall = ifelse(average_liabilities_to_assets_ratio_t4 > median_leverage_overall, 1, 0),
    overall_median_leverage = median_leverage_overall  # Add overall median as a constant column
  )

# Function to apply the merge of the calculated averages and dummy to multiple datasets
add_leverage_variables <- function(data) {
  data <- data %>%
    left_join(liabilities_assets_avg_t4, by = c("ID", "cantonal"))
  return(data)
}

# Apply this function to all the required datasets

# 1. panel_unbalanced_ratios_date
panel_unbalanced_ratios_date <- add_leverage_variables(panel_unbalanced_ratios_date)

# 2. panel_unbalanced_real_date
panel_unbalanced_real_date <- add_leverage_variables(panel_unbalanced_real_date)

panel_unbalanced_real_date <- panel_unbalanced_real_date %>%
  left_join(
    equity_add_sum %>% dplyr::select(ID, cantonal, t, total_equity),
    by = c("ID", "cantonal", "t")
  )

```

######## Main calculations generating datasets
```{r function for dataset preparation}

prepare_outcome <- function(
    data,
    categories,
    outcome,
    weight_label = outcome,
    periods = 2:7,
    duplicate_rows = NULL,
    adjust_sign = FALSE,
    winsor_probs = c(0.01, 0.99),
    additional_vars = NULL
) {

  # Variables retained at the ID × t level
  standard_vars <- c(
    post            = "post",
    leverage        = "average_liabilities_to_assets_ratio_t4",
    high_leverage   = "high_leverage_overall",
    cantonal        = "cantonal",
    private         = "private",
    log_total_assets = "log_total_assets"
  )

  retained_vars <- c(standard_vars, additional_vars)

  # 1. Select one or several categories
  filtered <- data %>%
    filter(Category %in% categories)

  # Show ID × t combinations containing multiple source rows.
  # With component categories, these are not necessarily duplicates.
  multiple_entries <- filtered %>%
    add_count(ID, t, name = "n_entries") %>%
    filter(n_entries > 1) %>%
    arrange(ID, t, Category)

  # Remove duplictes
  if (identical(categories, "Result")) {
  filtered <- filtered %>%
    arrange(ID, t, Value) %>%
    distinct(ID, t, Value, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

  # 2. Special cleaning for Result
  if (identical(categories, "Result")) {

    filtered <- filtered %>%
      group_by(ID, t) %>%
      mutate(
        n_entries = n(),
        has_year_in_name = str_detect(
          Name,
          "\\b(19[0-9]{2}|20[0-9]{2})\\b"
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(n_entries == 1 | !has_year_in_name) %>%
      select(-n_entries, -has_year_in_name) %>%
      ungroup()

    if (!is.null(duplicate_rows)) {

      remaining_duplicates <- filtered %>%
        group_by(Year, ID) %>%
        filter(n() > 1) %>%
        ungroup()

      valid_rows <- duplicate_rows[
        duplicate_rows <= nrow(remaining_duplicates)
      ]

      rows_to_remove <- remaining_duplicates[valid_rows, ]

      filtered <- filtered %>%
        anti_join(
          rows_to_remove,
          by = c("Name", "ID", "t", "Value")
        )
    }
  }

  # 3. Apply sign convention if requested
  filtered <- filtered %>%
    mutate(
      analysis_value = if (adjust_sign) {
        case_when(
          Assets == 1 ~ -Value,
          Liabilities == 1 ~ Value,

          Assets == 0 & Liabilities == 0 &
            str_detect(
              Name,
              regex("Gewinn", ignore_case = TRUE)
            ) ~ Value,

          Assets == 0 & Liabilities == 0 &
            str_detect(
              Name,
              regex("Verlust", ignore_case = TRUE)
            ) ~ -Value,

          Assets == 0 & Liabilities == 0 &
            str_detect(
              Name,
              regex("Passivsaldo", ignore_case = TRUE)
            ) ~ -Value,

          TRUE ~ Value
        )
      } else {
        Value
      }
    )

  # Check that requested retained variables exist
  missing_vars <- setdiff(unname(retained_vars), names(filtered))

  if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The following variables are missing from the data: ",
      paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # 4. Aggregate outcome and retain bank characteristics
  raw <- filtered %>%
    group_by(ID, t) %>%
    summarise(
      outcome_value = sum(analysis_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      across(
        all_of(unname(retained_vars)),
        ~ first(.x)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(
      !!!setNames(
        unname(retained_vars),
        names(retained_vars)
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(high_leverage),
      !is.na(leverage)
    ) %>%
    mutate(t = as.integer(as.character(t)))

  # Raw summary-statistics samples
  raw_t4 <- raw %>%
    filter(t == 4)

  # 5. Winsorize once within each period
  winsorized <- raw %>%
  group_by(t) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_value = DescTools::Winsorize(
      outcome_value,
      val = quantile(
        outcome_value,
        probs = winsor_probs,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_value = DescTools::Winsorize(
      outcome_value,
      val = quantile(
        outcome_value,
        probs = winsor_probs,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

  # 6. Construct complete ID × t grid
  full <- expand_grid(
    ID = unique(winsorized$ID),
    t = periods
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      winsorized,
      by = c("ID", "t")
    ) %>%
    arrange(ID, t) %>%
    mutate(
      post = as.integer(t > 4),
      observed = as.integer(!is.na(outcome_value))
    )

  # 7. Inclusion model
  inclusion_model <- glm(
    observed ~ factor(t) + factor(ID),
    family = binomial(),
    data = full
  )

  probability_name <- paste0("prob_inc_", weight_label)
  weight_name      <- paste0("IPW_", weight_label)

  # 8. Predicted inclusion probability and IPW
  full <- full %>%
    mutate(
      "{probability_name}" := predict(
        inclusion_model,
        newdata = full,
        type = "response"
      ),
      "{weight_name}" := if_else(
        observed == 1L,
        1 / pmax(.data[[probability_name]], 1e-4),
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    rename("{outcome}" := outcome_value)

  raw <- raw %>%
    rename("{outcome}" := outcome_value)

  raw_t4 <- raw_t4 %>%
    rename("{outcome}" := outcome_value)

  winsorized <- winsorized %>%
    rename("{outcome}" := outcome_value)

  list(
    raw              = raw,
    raw_t4           = raw_t4,
    panel            = pdata.frame(
      winsorized,
      index = c("ID", "t")
    ),
    winsorized       = winsorized,
    full             = full,
    inclusion_model  = inclusion_model,
    multiple_entries = multiple_entries
  )
}

```

```{r function for summary statistics}
make_summary_stats <- function(data, outcome) {

  all_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome]])) %>%
    mutate(group = "All")

  grouped_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[outcome]]),
      cantonal %in% c(0, 1)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      group = if_else(
        cantonal == 1,
        "State = 1",
        "State = 0"
      )
    )

  bind_rows(all_data, grouped_data) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      N      = n(),
      N_ID   = n_distinct(ID),
      mean   = mean(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd     = sd(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      min    = min(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      max    = max(.data[[outcome]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      group = factor(
        group,
        levels = c("All", "State = 1", "State = 0")
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(group)
}
```

```{r function for regression models}
estimate_outcome_models <- function(
    full_data,
    raw_data,
    raw_t4,
    outcome,
    weight,
    reference_period = 4
) {

  # Construct formulas
  ratio_nocontrol_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ leverage * i(t, ref = ",
      reference_period,
      ") | ID + t"
    )
  )

  ratio_control_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ leverage * cantonal * i(t, ref = ",
      reference_period,
      ") | ID + t"
    )
  )

  dummy_nocontrol_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ high_leverage * i(t, ref = ",
      reference_period,
      ") | ID + t"
    )
  )

  dummy_control_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ high_leverage * cantonal * i(t, ref = ",
      reference_period,
      ") | ID + t"
    )
  )

  # Weight formula
  weight_formula <- as.formula(paste0("~", weight))

  # Estimate models
  model_ratio_nocontrol <- feols(
    fml     = ratio_nocontrol_formula,
    data    = full_data,
    weights = weight_formula,
    vcov    = ~ID,
    fixef.rm = "none"
  )

  model_ratio_control <- feols(
    fml     = ratio_control_formula,
    data    = full_data,
    weights = weight_formula,
    vcov    = ~ID,
    fixef.rm = "none"
  )

  model_dummy_nocontrol <- feols(
    fml     = dummy_nocontrol_formula,
    data    = full_data,
    weights = weight_formula,
    vcov    = ~ID,
    fixef.rm = "none"
  )

  model_dummy_control <- feols(
    fml     = dummy_control_formula,
    data    = full_data,
    weights = weight_formula,
    vcov    = ~ID,
    fixef.rm = "none"
  )

  # Observations used in the baseline ratio model
  sample_rows <- fixest::obs(model_ratio_nocontrol)

  estimation_sample <- full_data[sample_rows, , drop = FALSE]

  # Summary statistics
  stats_estimation_sample <- make_summary_stats(
    estimation_sample,
    outcome
  )

  stats_t4_raw <- make_summary_stats(
    raw_t4,
    outcome
  )

  stats_all_raw <- make_summary_stats(
    raw_data,
    outcome
  )

  list(
    models = list(
      ratio_nocontrol = model_ratio_nocontrol,
      ratio_control   = model_ratio_control,
      dummy_nocontrol = model_dummy_nocontrol,
      dummy_control   = model_dummy_control
    ),
    estimation_sample = estimation_sample,
    summary_stats = list(
      estimation_sample = stats_estimation_sample,
      t4_raw             = stats_t4_raw,
      all_raw            = stats_all_raw
    )
  )
}
```

```{r baseline results ratio}
  baseline_ratio_models,
  headers = "Dependent variable",
  keep = "leverage",
  coefstat = "se",
  digits = 3,
  signif.code = c(
    "***" = 0.01,
    "**"  = 0.05,
```

```{r marginal effects}
library(dplyr)

model_objects <- list(
  dummy_profits         = results_profit$models$dummy_control,
  ratio_profits         = results_profit$models$ratio_control,
  dummy_equity          = results_equity$models$dummy_control,
  ratio_equity          = results_equity$models$ratio_control,
  dummy_loans           = results_loan$models$dummy_control,
  ratio_loans           = results_loan$models$ratio_control,
  dummy_assets_noloan   = results_assets_noloan$models$dummy_control,
  ratio_assets_noloan   = results_assets_noloan$models$ratio_control

  dummy_profits         = full_profit,
  ratio_profits         = full_profit,
  dummy_equity          = full_equity,
  ratio_equity          = full_equity,
  dummy_loans           = full_loan,
  ratio_loans           = full_loan,
  dummy_assets_noloan   = full_assets_noloan,
  ratio_assets_noloan   = full_assets_noloan
)

mfx_list <- list()

for (name in names(model_objects)) {

  model <- model_objects[[name]]

  # Use only observations with an observed outcome and positive IPW
  dataset <- model_data[[name]] %>%
    filter(
      observed == 1,
      t %in% 2:7
    )

  coefficient_names <- names(coef(model))

  if (any(grepl("high_leverage", coefficient_names))) {
    leverage_var <- "high_leverage"
  } else if (any(grepl("leverage", coefficient_names))) {
    leverage_var <- "leverage"
  } else {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Neither leverage nor high_leverage found in model",
        name
      )
    )
  }

  mfx_list[[name]] <- avg_slopes(
    model,
    variables = leverage_var,
    newdata = dataset,
    by = c("cantonal", "t")
  )
}

mfx_table <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(mfx_list), function(name) {

    as.data.frame(mfx_list[[name]]) %>%
      mutate(model = name)
  })
) %>%
  select(
    model,
    cantonal,
    t,
    term,
    contrast,
    estimate,
    std.error,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    p.value
  ) %>%
  arrange(model, cantonal, t)

mfx_table
```

```{r w/o winsorization}
make_unwinsorized_full <- function(
    full_data,
    raw_data,
    outcome
) {

  raw_outcome <- raw_data %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    transmute(
      ID = as.character(ID),
      t  = as.integer(as.character(t)),
      raw_outcome = .data[[outcome]]
    )

  full_data %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      ID = as.character(ID),
      t  = as.integer(as.character(t))
    ) %>%
    select(-all_of(outcome)) %>%
    left_join(
      raw_outcome,
      by = c("ID", "t")
    ) %>%
    rename(
      "{outcome}" := raw_outcome
    ) %>%
    arrange(ID, t)
}
```

######## Robustness Check - random assignment of leverage dummy:
```{r random assignment placebo function}

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(fixest)
library(broom)

run_placebo_experiment <- function(
    data,
    outcome,
    weight,
    B = 1000,
    seed = 42,
    reference_period = 4
) {

  # Use the already prepared and winsorized baseline dataset
  base_data <- data %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      ID = as.character(ID),
      t  = as.integer(as.character(t))
    ) %>%
    arrange(ID, t)

  outcome_formula_nocontrol <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ high_leverage_random * ",
      "i(t, ref = ",
      reference_period,
      ") | ID + t"
    )
  )

  outcome_formula_full <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ high_leverage_random * cantonal * ",
      "i(t, ref = ",
      reference_period,
      ") | ID + t"
    )
  )

  weight_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0("~", weight)
  )

  # Bank IDs used for random assignment
  bank_ids <- base_data %>%
    filter(
      observed == 1L,
      !is.na(.data[[outcome]]),
      !is.na(.data[[weight]])
    ) %>%
    distinct(ID) %>%
    arrange(ID) %>%
    pull(ID)

  number_treated <- length(bank_ids) %/% 2

  run_one_draw <- function(draw_number) {

    random_treated_ids <- sample(
      bank_ids,
      size = number_treated,
      replace = FALSE
    )

    random_assignment <- tibble(
      ID = bank_ids,
      high_leverage_random = as.integer(
        bank_ids %in% random_treated_ids
      )
    )

    draw_data <- base_data %>%
      left_join(
        random_assignment,
        by = "ID"
      )

    model_nocontrol <- feols(
      fml = outcome_formula_nocontrol,
      data = draw_data,
      weights = weight_formula,
      vcov = ~ID,
      fixef.rm = "none"
    )

    model_full <- feols(
      fml = outcome_formula_full,
      data = draw_data,
      weights = weight_formula,
      vcov = ~ID,
      fixef.rm = "none"
    )

    results_nocontrol <- broom::tidy(
      model_nocontrol
    ) %>%
      filter(
        grepl("high_leverage_random", term)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        model = "nocontrol",
        draw = draw_number
      )

    results_full <- broom::tidy(
      model_full
    ) %>%
      filter(
        grepl("high_leverage_random", term)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        model = "full",
        draw = draw_number
      )

    bind_rows(
      results_nocontrol,
      results_full
    )
  }

  # Each outcome receives the same reproducible master seed
  set.seed(seed)

  placebo_draws <- map_dfr(
    seq_len(B),
    run_one_draw,
    .progress = FALSE
  )

  placebo_summary <- placebo_draws %>%
    group_by(model, term) %>%
    summarise(
      repetitions = n(),
      mean_beta = mean(
        estimate,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      sd_beta = sd(
        estimate,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      p5 = quantile(
        estimate,
        probs = 0.05,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      p95 = quantile(
        estimate,
        probs = 0.95,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      sig_share_0.1 = mean(
        p.value < 0.10,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      sig_share_0.05 = mean(
        p.value < 0.05,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      sig_share_0.01 = mean(
        p.value < 0.01,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  list(
    draws = placebo_draws,
    summary = placebo_summary
  )
}
```

######## Robustness Check - use of balanced panel:

```{r Create correct balanced panel}

make_balanced_outcome_panel <- function(
    data,
    outcome,
    periods = 2:7
) {

  balanced_ids <- data %>%
    filter(t %in% periods) %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    summarise(
      periods_observed = n_distinct(
        t[!is.na(.data[[outcome]])]
      ),
      complete_outcome = all(
        !is.na(.data[[outcome]][t %in% periods])
      ),
      complete_leverage = all(
        !is.na(leverage[t %in% periods])
      ),
      complete_cantonal = all(
        !is.na(cantonal[t %in% periods])
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      periods_observed == length(periods),
      complete_outcome,
      complete_leverage,
      complete_cantonal
    ) %>%
    pull(ID)

  data %>%
    filter(
      ID %in% balanced_ids,
      t %in% periods
    ) %>%
    arrange(ID, t)
}

balanced_profit <- make_balanced_outcome_panel(
  data    = full_profit,
  outcome = "Profit_sum"
)

balanced_equity <- make_balanced_outcome_panel(
  data    = full_equity,
  outcome = "equity_sum"
)

balanced_loan <- make_balanced_outcome_panel(
  data    = full_loan,
  outcome = "loan_sum"
)

balanced_assets_noloan <- make_balanced_outcome_panel(
  data    = full_assets_noloan,
  outcome = "assets_sum"
)

```

```{r balanced panel marginal effects}
      "Non-government-linked banks"

      p.value < 0.01 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ ""
    ),
    estimate_formatted = paste0(

      "(",
      sprintf("%.3f", std.error),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(t != 4) %>%
  select(
    outcome,
    bank_type,
    cantonal,
    t,
    relative_period,
    estimate,
    std.error,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    p.value,

    estimate_formatted,
    se_formatted

    relative_period,
    outcome

    )

  arrange(

      bank_type,
      levels = c(
        "Non-government-linked banks",
        "Government-linked banks"
```

```{r heteroskedasticity robust standard errors}
library(dplyr)

# Confirm that all previously prepared datasets exist

estimate_ratio_models_hetero <- function(
    data,
    outcome,
    weight,
    reference_period = 4
) {

  formula_nocontrol <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ leverage * i(t, ref = ",
      reference_period,
      ") | ID + t"
    )
  )

  formula_control <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ leverage * cantonal * i(t, ref = ",
      reference_period,
      ") | ID + t"
    )
  )

  weight_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0("~", weight)
  )

  list(
    nocontrol = feols(
      fml = formula_nocontrol,
      data = data,
      weights = weight_formula,
      vcov = "hetero",
    fixef.rm = "none"
    ),

    control = feols(
      fml = formula_control,
      data = data,
      weights = weight_formula,
      vcov = "hetero",
      fixef.rm = "none"
    )
  )
}
```

```{r  bootstrapping standard errors}

cluster_bootstrap_model <- function(
    model,
    data,
    outcome,
    weight,
    control = FALSE,
    repetitions = 100,
    seed = 123
) {

  coefficient_names <- names(coef(model))
  bank_ids <- unique(data$ID)

  if (control) {
    bootstrap_formula <- as.formula(
      paste0(
        outcome,
        " ~ leverage * cantonal * ",
        "i(t, ref = 4) | boot_ID + t"
      )
    )
  } else {
    bootstrap_formula <- as.formula(
      paste0(
        outcome,
        " ~ leverage * ",
        "i(t, ref = 4) | boot_ID + t"
      )
    )
  }

  weight_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0("~", weight)
  )

  bootstrap_statistic <- function(ids, indices) {

    sampled_ids <- ids[indices]

    bootstrap_data <- bind_rows(
      lapply(
        seq_along(sampled_ids),
        function(draw_number) {

          selected_data <- data %>%
            filter(
              ID == sampled_ids[draw_number]
            )

          selected_data$boot_ID <- paste0(
            sampled_ids[draw_number],
            "_",
            draw_number
          )

          selected_data
        }
      )
    )

    output <- rep(
      NA_real_,
      length(coefficient_names)
    )

    names(output) <- coefficient_names

    bootstrap_model <- tryCatch(
      feols(
        fml = bootstrap_formula,
        data = bootstrap_data,
        weights = weight_formula,
        fixef.rm = "none"
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(bootstrap_model)) {
      return(output)
    }

    bootstrap_coefficients <- coef(
      bootstrap_model
    )

    common_coefficients <- intersect(
      names(output),
      names(bootstrap_coefficients)
    )

    output[common_coefficients] <-
      bootstrap_coefficients[common_coefficients]

    output
  }

  set.seed(seed)

  bootstrap_result <- boot::boot(
    data = bank_ids,
    statistic = bootstrap_statistic,
    R = repetitions
  )

  bootstrap_se <- setNames(
    apply(
      bootstrap_result$t,
      2,
      sd,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    coefficient_names
  )

  original_coefficients <- coef(model)

  results <- tibble(
    term = names(original_coefficients),
    estimate = as.numeric(original_coefficients),
    boot_se = as.numeric(
      bootstrap_se[
        names(original_coefficients)
      ]
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_stat = estimate / boot_se,
      p_value = 2 * pnorm(
        abs(t_stat),
        lower.tail = FALSE
      ),
      conf_low = estimate - 1.96 * boot_se,
      conf_high = estimate + 1.96 * boot_se
    )

  list(
    table = results,
    boot = bootstrap_result
  )
}

bootstrap_marginal_effects <- function(
    model,
    data,
    outcome,
    weight,
    repetitions = 100,
    seed = 123
) {

  estimation_rows <- fixest::obs(model)

  estimation_data <- data[
    estimation_rows,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  original_mfx <- avg_slopes(
    model,
    variables = "leverage",
    newdata = estimation_data,
    by = c("cantonal", "t")
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    arrange(cantonal, t)

  marginal_grid <- original_mfx %>%
    select(cantonal, t)

  bank_ids <- unique(data$ID)

  bootstrap_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ leverage * cantonal * ",
      "i(t, ref = 4) | boot_ID + t"
    )
  )

  weight_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0("~", weight)
  )

  bootstrap_statistic <- function(ids, indices) {

    sampled_ids <- ids[indices]

    bootstrap_data <- bind_rows(
      lapply(
        seq_along(sampled_ids),
        function(draw_number) {

          selected_data <- data %>%
            filter(
              ID == sampled_ids[draw_number]
            )

          selected_data$boot_ID <- paste0(
            sampled_ids[draw_number],
            "_",
            draw_number
          )

          selected_data
        }
      )
    )

    bootstrap_model <- tryCatch(
      feols(
        fml = bootstrap_formula,
        data = bootstrap_data,
        weights = weight_formula,
        fixef.rm = "none"
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(bootstrap_model)) {
      return(
        rep(
          NA_real_,
          nrow(marginal_grid)
        )
      )
    }

    bootstrap_sample_rows <- fixest::obs(
      bootstrap_model
    )

    bootstrap_estimation_data <- bootstrap_data[
      bootstrap_sample_rows,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    bootstrap_mfx <- tryCatch(
      avg_slopes(
        bootstrap_model,
        variables = "leverage",
        newdata = bootstrap_estimation_data,
        by = c("cantonal", "t")
      ) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        select(
          cantonal,
          t,
          estimate
        ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(bootstrap_mfx)) {
      return(
        rep(
          NA_real_,
          nrow(marginal_grid)
        )
      )
    }

    marginal_grid %>%
      left_join(
        bootstrap_mfx,
        by = c("cantonal", "t")
      ) %>%
      pull(estimate)
  }

  set.seed(seed)

  bootstrap_result <- boot::boot(
    data = bank_ids,
    statistic = bootstrap_statistic,
    R = repetitions
  )

  original_mfx %>%
    mutate(
      boot_se = apply(
        bootstrap_result$t,
        2,
        sd,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      t_stat_boot = estimate / boot_se,
      p_value_boot = 2 * pnorm(
        abs(t_stat_boot),
        lower.tail = FALSE
      ),
      conf_low_boot =
        estimate - 1.96 * boot_se,
      conf_high_boot =
        estimate + 1.96 * boot_se
    )
}
```

######## Leave one out and leave one in

```{r leave one in or out}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(fixest)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Harmonize key types
# ------------------------------------------------------------
panel_unbalanced_real_date <- panel_unbalanced_real_date %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    cantonal = as.character(cantonal)
  )

full_equity <- full_equity %>%
  mutate(
    ID = as.character(ID),
    cantonal = as.character(cantonal)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Assets
# ------------------------------------------------------------
assets_sum <- panel_unbalanced_real_date %>%
  filter(Category == "Sum of Assets") %>%
  group_by(ID, t, cantonal) %>%
  summarise(
    total_assets = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Liability codes
#    Keep 3.3.3 separate from 3.3
# ------------------------------------------------------------
liab_lvl2 <- panel_unbalanced_real_date %>%
  mutate(
    code_full = str_extract(
      Category,
      "(?<=\\()3(?:\\.\\d+){1,2}(?=\\))"
    ),
    code_lvl2 = str_extract(code_full, "^3\\.\\d"),
    code_group = case_when(
      code_full == "3.3.3" ~ "3.3.3",
      TRUE ~ code_lvl2
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    code_lvl2 %in% c(
      "3.1",
      "3.2",
      "3.3",
      "3.4",
      "3.5"
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Function to build leverage ratio at t = 4
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_debt_t4 <- function(
  liab_data,
  assets_data,
  keep_codes
){

  liab_data %>%
    filter(code_group %in% keep_codes) %>%

    group_by(ID, t, cantonal) %>%
    summarise(
      total_debt = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%

    inner_join(
      assets_data,
      by = c("ID", "t", "cantonal")
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      debt_ratio = total_debt / total_assets
    ) %>%

    filter(t == 4) %>%

    group_by(ID, cantonal) %>%
    summarise(
      debt_t4 = mean(debt_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Liability groups
# ------------------------------------------------------------
codes_all <- c(
  "3.1",
  "3.2",
  "3.3",
  "3.3.3",
  "3.4",
  "3.5"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Baseline model
# ------------------------------------------------------------
debt_t4_all <- build_debt_t4(
  liab_lvl2,
  assets_sum,
  codes_all
) %>%
  rename(debt_t4_all = debt_t4)

full_equity_all <- full_equity %>%
  inner_join(
    debt_t4_all,
    by = c("ID", "cantonal")
  )

m_full <- feols(
  equity_sum ~ i(t, debt_t4_all, ref = 4) |
    ID + t,
  data = full_equity_all,
  weights = ~IPW_equity,
  vcov = ~ID,
  fixef.rm = "none"
)

# ============================================================
# LEAVE-ONE-OUT
# ============================================================

models_leaveout <- list()

for(drop_code in codes_all){

  keep_codes <- setdiff(
    codes_all,
    drop_code
  )

  debt_tmp <- build_debt_t4(
    liab_lvl2,
    assets_sum,
    keep_codes
  )

  tmp_panel <- full_equity %>%
    inner_join(
      debt_tmp,
      by = c("ID", "cantonal")
    )

  models_leaveout[[paste0(
    "drop_",
    drop_code
  )]] <- feols(
    equity_sum ~ i(t, debt_t4, ref = 4) |
      ID + t,
    data = tmp_panel,
    weights = ~IPW_equity,
    vcov = ~ID,
  fixef.rm = "none"
  )
}

etable(
  m_full,
  models_leaveout,
  headers = c(
    "Baseline",
    "-3.1",
    "-3.2",
    "-3.3",
    "-3.3.3",
    "-3.4",
    "-3.5"
  ),
  dict = c(
    "debt_t4_all" = "Leverage ratio",
    "debt_t4" = "Leverage ratio"
  )
)

# ============================================================
# LEAVE-ONE-IN
# ============================================================

models_leavein <- list()

for(keep_code in codes_all){

  debt_tmp <- build_debt_t4(
    liab_lvl2,
    assets_sum,
    keep_codes = keep_code
  )

  tmp_panel <- full_equity %>%
    inner_join(
      debt_tmp,
      by = c("ID", "cantonal")
    )

  models_leavein[[paste0(
    "keep_",
    keep_code
  )]] <- feols(
    equity_sum ~ i(t, debt_t4, ref = 4) |
      ID + t,
    data = tmp_panel,
    weights = ~IPW_equity,
    vcov = ~ID,
    fixef.rm = "none"
  )
}

etable(
  m_full,
  models_leavein,
  headers = c(
    "Baseline",
    "Only 3.1",
    "Only 3.2",
    "Only 3.3",
    "Only 3.3.3",
    "Only 3.4",
    "Only 3.5"
  ),
  dict = c(
    "debt_t4_all" = "Leverage ratio",
    "debt_t4" = "Leverage ratio"
  )
)
```

```{r baseline split sample by cantonal}
estimate_split_ratio <- function(
    data,
    outcome,
    weight,
    cantonal_value,
    reference_period = 4
) {

  model_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      outcome,
      " ~ leverage * i(t, ref = ",
      reference_period,
      ") | ID + t"
    )
  )

  weight_formula <- as.formula(
    paste0("~", weight)
  )

  feols(
    fml = model_formula,
    data = data %>%
      filter(
        cantonal == cantonal_value,
        observed == 1L,
        !is.na(.data[[outcome]]),
        !is.na(.data[[weight]]),
        .data[[weight]] > 0
      ),
    weights = weight_formula,
    vcov = ~ID,
    fixef.rm = "none"
  )
}
```
